name: Checkin Toggle
script:
user = frappe.session.user
employee = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", {"user_id": user}, "name")

if not employee:
    frappe.throw("No Employee linked to this user")

OFFICE_LAT = float(frappe.db.get_single_value("Logikview Checkin Settings", "latitude"))
OFFICE_LON = float(frappe.db.get_single_value("Logikview Checkin Settings", "longitude"))
ALLOWED_RADIUS_KM = float(frappe.db.get_single_value("Logikview Checkin Settings", "radius_km"))

user_lat = frappe.form_dict.get("latitude")
user_lon = frappe.form_dict.get("longitude")

if not user_lat or not user_lon:
    frappe.throw("Location access is mandatory. Please enable GPS and try again.")

user_lat = float(user_lat)
user_lon = float(user_lon)

accuracy_raw = frappe.form_dict.get("accuracy")
try:
    accuracy_val = float(accuracy_raw) if accuracy_raw not in (None, "") else None
except Exception:
    accuracy_val = None

distance = (((user_lat - OFFICE_LAT)**2 + (user_lon - OFFICE_LON)**2) ** 0.5) * 111
log_location_tag = "Office" if distance <= ALLOWED_RADIUS_KM else "Work From Home"

# ========================
# DETERMINE NEXT LOG TYPE
# ========================
today = frappe.utils.today()

last_log = frappe.get_all(
    "Employee Checkin",
    filters={
        "employee": employee,
        "time": [">=", today]
    },
    fields=["log_type", "name", "time"],
    order_by="time desc",
    limit=1
)

next_log_type = "OUT" if (last_log and last_log[0].log_type == "IN") else "IN"

# ========================
# DUPLICATE PREVENTION
# ========================
if last_log:
    last_log_time = frappe.utils.get_datetime(last_log[0].get("time"))
    seconds_since_last = (frappe.utils.now_datetime() - last_log_time).total_seconds()
    if seconds_since_last < 10:
        frappe.response["message"] = {
            "status": "error",
            "error": "Please wait a moment before checking in or out again."
        }
        raise SystemExit()

# ========================
# FETCH SHIFT — null end_date fallback
# ========================
shift = frappe.db.get_value(
    "Shift Assignment",
    {
        "employee": employee,
        "status": "Active",
        "start_date": ["<=", today],
        "end_date": [">=", today]
    },
    "shift_type"
)

if not shift:
    shift = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Shift Assignment",
        {
            "employee": employee,
            "status": "Active",
            "start_date": ["<=", today],
            "end_date": ["in", ["", None]]
        },
        "shift_type"
    )

# ========================
# CREATE CHECKIN
# ========================
checkin = frappe.get_doc({
    "doctype": "Employee Checkin",
    "employee": employee,
    "log_type": next_log_type,
    "time": frappe.utils.now_datetime(),
    "device_id": log_location_tag,
    "latitude": user_lat,
    "longitude": user_lon,
    "shift": shift,
    "custom_location_accuracy": accuracy_val
})
checkin.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
frappe.db.commit()

# ========================
# ON CHECKOUT — instantly calculate and write attendance
# ========================
if next_log_type == "OUT":

    all_logs = frappe.get_all(
        "Employee Checkin",
        filters={
            "employee": employee,
            "time": [">=", today]
        },
        fields=["log_type", "time"],
        order_by="time asc"
    )

    total_seconds = 0
    last_in_time = None
    first_in_time = None

    for log in all_logs:
        t = frappe.utils.get_datetime(log["time"])
        if log["log_type"] == "IN":
            if first_in_time is None:
                first_in_time = t
            last_in_time = t
        elif log["log_type"] == "OUT" and last_in_time:
            total_seconds += (t - last_in_time).total_seconds()
            last_in_time = None

    working_hours = round(total_seconds / 3600, 4)

    # ========================
    # LATE ENTRY / EARLY EXIT FLAGS
    # ========================
    late_entry = 0
    early_exit = 0
    actual_out_time = frappe.utils.now_datetime()
    half_day_threshold = 0

    if shift:
        shift_doc = frappe.get_doc("Shift Type", shift)
        half_day_threshold = shift_doc.working_hours_threshold_for_half_day or 0

        if shift_doc.start_time and first_in_time:
            shift_start_today = frappe.utils.get_datetime(today + " " + str(shift_doc.start_time))
            grace_in = shift_doc.late_entry_grace_period or 0
            late_boundary = shift_start_today + frappe.utils.datetime.timedelta(minutes=grace_in)
            if first_in_time > late_boundary:
                late_entry = 1

        if shift_doc.end_time:
            shift_end_today = frappe.utils.get_datetime(today + " " + str(shift_doc.end_time))
            grace_out = shift_doc.early_exit_grace_period or 0
            early_boundary = shift_end_today - frappe.utils.datetime.timedelta(minutes=grace_out)
            if actual_out_time < early_boundary:
                early_exit = 1

    att_status = "Half Day" if (half_day_threshold and working_hours < half_day_threshold) else "Present"

    # ========================
    # WRITE ATTENDANCE
    # ========================
    existing_att = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Attendance",
        {
            "employee": employee,
            "attendance_date": today,
            "docstatus": ["!=", 2]
        },
        "name"
    )

    if existing_att:
        frappe.db.set_value(
            "Attendance",
            existing_att,
            {
                "working_hours": working_hours,
                "status": att_status,
                "late_entry": late_entry,
                "early_exit": early_exit
            }
        )
        frappe.db.commit()
    else:
        company = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", employee, "company")
        att = frappe.get_doc({
            "doctype": "Attendance",
            "employee": employee,
            "attendance_date": today,
            "status": att_status,
            "working_hours": working_hours,
            "shift": shift,
            "company": company,
            "late_entry": late_entry,
            "early_exit": early_exit
        })
        att.flags.ignore_permissions = True
        att.flags.ignore_validate = True
        att.insert(ignore_permissions=True)
        frappe.db.set_value("Attendance", att.name, "docstatus", 1)
        frappe.db.commit()

frappe.response["message"] = {
    "status": "success",
    "log_type": next_log_type,
    "location_type": log_location_tag,
    "time": str(checkin.time)
}

name: Today Working Hours
script:
user = frappe.session.user
employee = frappe.db.get_value("Employee", {"user_id": user}, "name")

if not employee:
    frappe.response["message"] = {}
else:
    today = frappe.utils.today()

    # ========================
    # FETCH ALL TODAY'S LOGS
    # ========================
    logs = frappe.get_all(
        "Employee Checkin",
        filters={
            "employee": employee,
            "time": [">=", today]
        },
        fields=["log_type", "time"],
        order_by="time asc"
    )

    total_seconds = 0
    last_in_time = None

    for log in logs:
        t = frappe.utils.get_datetime(log["time"])
        if log["log_type"] == "IN":
            last_in_time = t
        elif log["log_type"] == "OUT" and last_in_time:
            total_seconds += (t - last_in_time).total_seconds()
            last_in_time = None

    # If currently checked in, add live running session
    is_checked_in = last_in_time is not None
    if is_checked_in:
        total_seconds += (frappe.utils.now_datetime() - last_in_time).total_seconds()

    # ========================
    # FETCH SHIFT — null end_date fallback
    # ========================
    shift_name = frappe.db.get_value(
        "Shift Assignment",
        {
            "employee": employee,
            "status": "Active",
            "start_date": ["<=", today],
            "end_date": [">=", today]
        },
        "shift_type"
    )

    if not shift_name:
        shift_name = frappe.db.get_value(
            "Shift Assignment",
            {
                "employee": employee,
                "status": "Active",
                "start_date": ["<=", today],
                "end_date": ["in", ["", None]]
            },
            "shift_type"
        )

    required_seconds = 8.5 * 3600

    if shift_name:
        shift_doc = frappe.get_doc("Shift Type", shift_name)
        if shift_doc.start_time and shift_doc.end_time:
            shift_start = frappe.utils.get_datetime("2000-01-01 " + str(shift_doc.start_time))
            shift_end = frappe.utils.get_datetime("2000-01-01 " + str(shift_doc.end_time))
            required_seconds = (shift_end - shift_start).total_seconds()

    # ========================
    # FORMAT TIMES
    # ========================
    def_h = int(total_seconds // 3600)
    def_m = int((total_seconds % 3600) // 60)
    def_s = int(total_seconds % 60)
    
    worked_str = f"{def_h:02}:{def_m:02}:{def_s:02}"
    
    req_h = int(required_seconds // 3600)
    req_m = int((required_seconds % 3600) // 60)
    req_s = int(required_seconds % 60)
    
    required_str = f"{req_h:02}:{req_m:02}:{req_s:02}"

    # ========================
    # COLOR LOGIC
    # ========================
    if total_seconds >= required_seconds:
        color = "green"
    elif total_seconds >= (required_seconds * 0.6):
        color = "orange"
    else:
        color = "red"

    frappe.response["message"] = {
        "worked": worked_str,
        "required": required_str,
        "worked_seconds": total_seconds,
        "required_seconds": required_seconds,
        "color": color,
        "is_checked_in": is_checked_in
    }
